rationale: The four-setting first-repeat far evolved-fixed I level is already positive at update200 and weakens thereafter. Exact original t0→200 reproduction+RNG is needed to locate historical origin of this signed difference before attributing it to later gradients.
per_case_enrollment: All 64 original far visitor histories and both already-frozen A policies in all four original reproductive settings.
source_parity: Exact source t200 diploid state alleles from authentic source .npz and source trace, zero tolerance. No comparable source original ID/birth-year receipt exists.
annual_exact_arithmetic: Let p be normalized conditional joint father-mother+self offspring genetic mean shift in I (Price response). For every transition with adult survivors s and resident recruits r, I_next-I_old = (s/Nnext)(I_surv-I_old)+(r/Nnext)*p+(r/Nnext)*(I_recruited-I_old-p). No immigrant seeds allowed. This is mathematical accounting, not causally unique selection/drift mediation.
per_case_fields: exact realized postreproduction parentage for t0..199
I_mean, A_expression, I allelic support, visitor richness, F/P/S
conditional one-step Price I, realized next I, and exact annual survivor/expected-recruit/realized-recruit decomposition
primary_retrospective_question: At what source years does the mean far E-F I level turn positive, and is the exact early t0→200 difference in realized I numerically carried by Price-weighted parental, survivor-sampling or realized-recruited residual terms? Report all three without causal-share language.
analysis: Pair fixed and evolvable histories within original external visitor seed; 64 independent history clusters; 4096 descriptive cluster-bootstrap draws for sums and t200 contrasts; no confirmatory p-values or new ecological-law claim.
negative_findings_preserved: If all terms are heterogeneous or uncertainties overlap zero, mechanism remains unidentified.
A positive sum of any arithmetic contribution is not a natural mediation effect.
The positive t200 source E-F does not imply positive year-specific selection at t400.
No visitor-free state makes the investment-cost gradient zero: beta_I=-2*c_I*I.
No mutation rescue/new genetic founder/different visitor histories are generated.
source_evidence_limit: Original archived source t200 contains alleles but not IDs, age or parentage; replay uses exact original RNG inputs and source code, and endpoint genotype equality, but original parentage arrays are not independently authenticated.
workflow_gate: All four reproduction modes source t200 parity must pass and all 102400 annual accounting identities must hold. Keep raw arrays, case receipts, original source ZIP hashes, and source/producer commit SHA. All 64 histories must be included.
future_direction: Combine source 0..200 accounting with prior post-t200 matched future experiment to isolate early divergence versus subsequent persistence; do not mix independent Q3, Q4 cohorts into source causal mediation.
